# The two node-option builders over one plant (census C4 <-> C7, the twins by their own comments).
# Go: buildNodePickerOptions (handlers_test_orders.go, the Test orders page): no headings, roots by zone then name.
# JS: buildNodeOptionsHTML (static/pages/orders.js, the Orders page's manual order): <optgroup> per zone.
# A line is: value | label as drawn. Bugs pinned as is are named under the lists.

Go (value is .Name; the Direct tab posts .ID instead)
Go  SPOT-9         | SPOT-9
Go  VIRT-1         | VIRT-1  · group
Go  _ROBOT:AMR-01  | _ROBOT:AMR-01  · group
Go  _TRANSIT       | _TRANSIT  · group
Go  GRP-A          | GRP-A  · group
Go  GRP-A-L1       |   ↳ GRP-A-L1  · lane
Go  GRP-A-L1-S1    |     ↳ GRP-A-L1-S1
Go  GRP-A-L1-S2    |     ↳ GRP-A-L1-S2
Go  GRP-B          | GRP-B  · group
Go  GRP-B-N1       |   ↳ GRP-B-N1
Go  GRP-B-N2       |   ↳ GRP-B-N2
Go  GRP-OFF-N1     | GRP-OFF-N1
Go  LINE-1         | LINE-1

JS (value is the node name)
JS  [ZONE-1] GRP-A  · group
JS  [ZONE-1]   GRP-A-L1  · lane
JS  [ZONE-1]   ↳ GRP-A-L1-S1
JS  [ZONE-1]   ↳ GRP-A-L1-S2
JS  [ZONE-1] OLD-SLOT  (off: disabled)
JS  [ZONE-2] GRP-B  · group
JS  [ZONE-2]   GRP-B-N1
JS  [ZONE-2]   GRP-B-N2
JS  [ZONE-2] GRP-OFF  · group  (off: disabled)
JS  [ZONE-2]   GRP-OFF-N1
JS  [ZONE-2] LINE-1  · Line one
JS  [Other] SPOT-9
JS  [Other] VIRT-1  · synthetic
JS  [Other] _ROBOT:AMR-01  · robot  (off: a robot, not a place)

Offered by Go, not by JS:
  _TRANSIT
Offered by JS, not by Go:
  OLD-SLOT
  GRP-OFF
Offered by neither: 

Pinned as is:
  census #6: JS zoneOf looks one level down, so GRP-A (children are lanes, no zone) files under Other.
  JS stops at one level and buckets by zone first: a lane's slots (depth 2) and the member of a
  disabled group (its parent is in byId but never drawn) are not offered at all.
  Name order differs: Go sorts bytes (_ROBOT, _TRANSIT after the letters), JS localeCompare (before).
  Both: _TRANSIT, the robot deck and VIRT-1 are offered, badged "group" (nodeTypeLabel: synthetic = group).
  Both: labels use .Name; LINE-1's display name is not shown.
